description: This file declares the TpmKeyBlobMaker class, which handles encryption and decryption of key data using TPM-resident keys, including creating, unwrapping, and setting system version information related to TPM key management.

classes.name: TpmKeyBlobMaker
classes.description: A class for managing TPM-based key blob creation, unwrapping, and system version configuration, extending the SoftwareKeyBlobMaker class.

methods.name: TpmKeyBlobMaker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TpmKeyBlobMaker with a reference to a TpmResourceManager.

methods.name: CreateKeyBlob
methods.description: Creates a key blob using TPM-resident keys, with key description, origin, and key material.

methods.name: UnvalidatedCreateKeyBlob
methods.description: Creates a key blob without validation, using key material and authorization sets.

methods.name: UnwrapKeyBlob
methods.description: Performs decryption operations shared between TPM-Keymaster keys, unwrapping a key blob into key material.

methods.name: SetSystemVersion
methods.description: Sets the OS version and patch level for TPM key management.
